nodes.name: Check config
nodes.notes: Why Code: validates the loaded config so a bad value fails loudly instead of silently disabling a check

parameters.errorMessage: ={{ 'approve-invoice failed for ' + $input.all().length + ' row(s); see its failed executions.' }}

parameters.content:
## Poll for approvals
Every 5 minutes: loads and checks the config, then reads the `Invoices` rows still in `review`. `pnpm run setup` leaves it unpublished until the Sheets credential exists.

## Approve each corrected row
A reviewer fixes the cells and types their name in `approved_by`. Only rows with that name and with their `invoice_id` and `email_id` go on, one call to approve-invoice each. A failed call is reported once for the whole batch.
